content.content:
448:- **Prevents:** an analytics, crash, ads or network SDK arriving directly or transitively; GPL, non-commercial or research-only components; a native library blocking Play upload; the install growing past budget.
850:  - **SDK levels.** minSdk 31, targetSdk 36, compileSdk 37.
1125:| Android SDK levels (min / target / compile) | 31 / 36 / 37 |
| Time | Durations come from the monotonic clock, in ms. Persisted instants are trusted UTC epoch ms. Server operations use UTC days; play rules use the profile Day (`DayRolledOver`) |
| Data formats | JSON through kotlinx.serialization with explicit names. `v` is `major.minor`. The voice turn is multipart: a JSON contract part plus an Ogg Opus part. Rasters ship as WebP; audio as Ogg Opus or Vorbis |
| Errors | Adapters return typed results and never throw across a port. Server codes follow AD-35. The child view never shows an error screen |
| State mutation | Commands go to the owner through its core interface (AD-2). UI state is immutable snapshots via Flow |
| Logging | The app logs no content in release builds. Typed loggers reject child-content types and fields outside the allowlist. Native runtimes log at error level |
| Configuration | Counsel values live in `:core:policy`; UX tuning values in one file in `:core:engine`; flags are flavor constants. Runtime data arrives only as signed envelopes (AD-16) |
| Concurrency | Kotlin coroutines. One shared lifecycle lock for native engines; one serial executor per engine for inference. The main thread never blocks on I/O |
| Testing | Core: JVM unit and property tests. Contract tests on three runtimes. Robolectric for adapters. Macrobenchmark for timing. In CI: payload, allowlist, licence, alignment, size, never-ship, canary-name, module-graph, write-port and migration tests. TalkBack and Switch Access tests |
| Server API | REST over HTTPS. Per-submission IDs on counters, reports, outbox items, and code, access and change-notice requests |
| Secrets | Offline keys sit on hardware tokens (AD-37). Online keys stay in the local signer process. Other server secrets are Compose file secrets in `/run/secrets` (mode 0400), never in the repo. The Play service account gets view-financial-data only, and is rotated every 90 days. The app holds only public keys |
